name: ki-vat-reference
description: Kiribati VAT reference for ordinary taxable businesses in 2026: rates, registration, exemptions, input apportionment, invoices, quarterly returns/payment, imports, refunds, penalties and worked figures. Includes original foreign-investment fees, certificate reporting and transfers alongside attributed business/employer registration and PAYE/KPF guidance and selected company-information amendments. Trigger on Kiribati VAT, RET 020, business registration, investment certificates, financial statements, PAYE or KPF. Refuses voluntary registration, gambling, foreign suppliers/platforms, going concern transfers and return lodgement with imported services. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and does not establish filing readiness, complete current law or an actual applicant's eligibility.
